qualifier: presynapse organization and synaptic protein localization
name: Regulation of synapse assembly and presynapse organization
rationale: All members regulate synapse formation (positive/negative synapse assembly, presynapse organization, protein localization to synapse), whereas confusables centre on trans-synaptic adhesion molecules and postsynaptic receptor/scaffold clustering.

qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase pumping and tight-junction paracellular transport
name: Cation homeostasis by Na+/K+-ATPase and tight-junction paracellular transport
rationale: Members concern intracellular Na+, K+ and Mg2+ homeostasis via P-type ATPase gradients (glycoside response) and paracellular tight-junction transport, unlike confusables built on chloride cotransporters, vasopressin water handling or K+ channel families.

name: RB-E2F control of G1/S transition
rationale: Members cover RB/p107/p130 repression of E2F targets, cyclin D degradation, CDK4/6 and cyclin E:CDK2 activity and p27/p21 turnover at G1/S, whereas confusables extend to replication origin licensing or G2/M events.

qualifier: adrenal and gonadal steroidogenic CYP pathways
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroid hormone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are corticosteroid, androgen, estrogen and progestin synthesis and its regulation, including steroidogenic CYP enzyme defects, distinguishing them from vitamin A/D/K metabolic CYPs and from cortisol secretion/response confusables.

core: Glycine and proline plasma membrane transport
name: Glycine and proline transport defective in iminoglycinuria
rationale: Members concern glycine and proline import by SLC6A20/SLC36A2 proton-coupled transporters and their iminoglycinuria variants, unlike confusables on cystine, cationic/neutral amino acids, organic ions or Hartnup tryptophan transport.

qualifier: ER/sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic clearance outside cardiac context
name: Regulation of ER calcium release and cytosolic calcium reduction
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium (ryanodine receptor, skeletal muscle) and lower cytosolic calcium via Na+/Ca2+ exchange and sequestration, without the cardiac contraction or store-operated entry pathways of the confusables.

core: Synaptic vesicle and neurotransmitter receptor trafficking
name: Rab/ARF-regulated synaptic vesicle and receptor trafficking
rationale: Members cover presynaptic vesicle cycling and active zone structure plus postsynaptic receptor endosomal trafficking, together with Rab/ARF signalling and RabGAPs, which the clathrin-endocytosis and dendrite-extension confusables lack.

name: MMP-mediated collagen degradation
rationale: All three members describe collagen catabolism and the activation of the metalloproteinases that perform it, distinct from ECM gene modules, fibrinolysis or integrin/fibronectin matrix assembly confusables.

qualifier: ER targeting, ER-Golgi and Golgi-endosome vesicle transport
name: Secretory and endosomal vesicle trafficking via ER and Golgi
rationale: Members span ER protein targeting and folding, COPI/COPII ER-Golgi transport, Golgi organization, Rab/ARF regulation and Golgi-endosome-lysosome routing, unlike autophagy, ESCRT or ER-stress response confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling and drug-reward behavior
rationale: Members combine D1/D2-type dopamine receptor signalling (adenylate cyclase, PLC, beta-arrestin, DARPP-32) with behavioural responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and opioids, whereas confusables cover dopamine synthesis/transport, ethanol, neuropeptides or social behaviours.

qualifier: NADPH regeneration, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
name: Cellular redox homeostasis via NADPH, ascorbate and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover ROS detoxification, NADPH/NADP+ supply, ascorbate and BH4 metabolism and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification, lacking the glutathione synthesis, ferroptosis-promoting and DNA alkylation repair pathways of the confusables.

core: Activity-dependent CREB signaling to the nucleus
name: CaMK-mediated CREB activation in synapse-to-nucleus memory signaling
rationale: Members describe postsynapse-to-nucleus signalling via CaMKK/CaMKIV phosphorylation of CREB, NPAS4 induction and long-term memory, unlike the MECP2 or cAMP/PKA-driven CREB confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and promoter escape
rationale: All members cover Pol II pre-initiation complex assembly, promoter opening and escape, stopping before the elongation, pausing, HIV Tat or nucleotide excision repair steps of the confusables.

qualifier: cranial and peripheral nerve and ganglion development
name: Axon guidance and cranial and peripheral nerve development
rationale: Members cover axon guidance of specific neuron types and development of cranial nerves, cranial/dorsal root ganglia and sympathetic/GnRH neuron migration, unlike confusables on hindbrain patterning, spinal cord specification or semaphorin/netrin signalling machinery.

core: Canonical NF-kB activation by toll-like receptors
name: TLR-induced TAK1 and IKK activation driving canonical NF-kB
rationale: Members describe IRAK1/2-, TRAF6- and RIP1/TICAM1-mediated TAK1 and IKK recruitment leading to canonical NF-kB, unlike confusables on non-canonical NF-kB or TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 interferon arms.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
name: 3'UTR RNA-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members are RNA-binding proteins (HuR, TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, IGF2BPs, L13a) acting on 3'UTRs to stabilize, destabilize or silence mRNAs, unlike the miRNA silencing, stress granule or decapping confusables.
